description: §52.13.2 (S449 ruling item 4; g-auth-attr-invalid-or-dynamic-value-compiles-to-no-auth) — a NON-literal `<program auth=@mode>` is E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID. Before S449 this shape (and `auth=${…}`, bare `auth`) compiled with no diagnostic to a PUBLIC app; #1234 made it W-ATTR-002; the ruling makes it an error and the build writes nothing. Not treated as a gate by the login lints.
rationale: §52.13.2 as amended S449 (supersedes the W-ATTR-002 + 'no auth gate at all' sentences). Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 "RULED — 'your recs.'" item 4 — 'Unrecognized / non-literal `auth=` (incl. `""`) = (a): compile error; amend §52.13.2 (supersedes its W-ATTR-002 + "no auth gate" SHALL).'
